worker_output.summary: Implemented TurnSummaryScreen that shows after Next Turn. Displays research progress, ships built, combats, and colonization events grouped by type with emoji icons. Continue button + ESC dismisses and returns to galaxy map. If no events, shows 'Nothing of note occurred'. Added TurnEvent type and turnEvents[] to GameState. Updated processTurn to collect events by comparing pre/post turn state. Screen is wired into App as a modal overlay with z-index 9999.
